answer: Sybils break on attention: each identity periodically faces a short novel task bound to a recent ledger hash, due inside a tight random window. One operator can staff only so many shells — when probes land on overlapping schedules, its fakes queue behind a single attention pipe and their completion times correlate, a shared heartbeat across an ocean of masks. Each on-time proof is an ivory token of separate presence; each correlated miss is a tell. Farms scatter a nebula of missed deadlines, and standing discounts any two identities whose responsiveness moves in lockstep.
